## 🎓 Bachelor’s‑Degree Attainment by Race (2021 ACS 1‑Year)

```{r}
#| label: load-and-plot
#| message: false
#| warning: false

library(tidycensus)
library(tidyverse)
library(janitor)
library(ggplot2)
library(forcats)
library(scales)

# ── cache file so we don't re‑download each render ─────────────────────────────
data_file <- "race_edu_la_2021.rds"

if (file.exists(data_file)) {
  edu_race <- readRDS(data_file)

} else {
  # race‑specific educational‑attainment variables (table B15002* in ACS‑1)
  race_vars <- c(
    "B15002A_001", "B15002A_015",  # White: total & bachelor's
    "B15002B_001", "B15002B_015",  # Black
    "B15002D_001", "B15002D_015",  # Asian
    "B15002I_001", "B15002I_015"   # Hispanic
  )

  raw <- get_acs(
    geography = "county",
    state     = "CA",
    county    = "Los Angeles",
    variables = race_vars,
    year      = 2021,
    survey    = "acs1",          # ← 1‑year release (needed for B15002A etc.)
    output    = "wide"
  ) %>% 
    clean_names()

  edu_race <- tibble(
    race = c("White", "Black", "Asian", "Hispanic / Latino"),
    percent_bachelors = c(
      raw$b15002a_015e / raw$b15002a_001e,
      raw$b15002b_015e / raw$b15002b_001e,
      raw$b15002d_015e / raw$b15002d_001e,
      raw$b15002i_015e / raw$b15002i_001e
    ) * 100
  )

  saveRDS(edu_race, data_file)
}

# ── plot ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
ggplot(
  edu_race,
  aes(
    x    = percent_bachelors,
    y    = fct_reorder(race, percent_bachelors),
    fill = race
  )
) +
  geom_col(show.legend = FALSE, width = 0.6) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = sprintf("%.1f%%", percent_bachelors)),
    hjust = -0.15, size = 5
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    labels = label_percent(scale = 1),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.15))
  ) +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2") +
  labs(
    x        = NULL,
    y        = NULL,
    title    = "Bachelor’s Degree Attainment by Race (Los Angeles County, 2021)",
    subtitle = "Source: 2021 ACS 1‑year, Table B15002*",
    caption  = "Note: ACS 1‑year data used because race‑specific tables are not\navailable in the 5‑year release."
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 16) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    plot.caption       = element_text(size = 10, margin = margin(t = 10))
  )
```
